in_arabic.name: Mandal
in_arabic.long_meaning: Mandal هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root ‘mdl’, meaning ‘to fight’, Mandal is a powerful name evoking images of courage and strength. In Islamic tradition, it symbolizes the inner warrior striving for faith and righteousness, as well as the external battles fought in the path of Allah.
